arguments.message:
Sure! When you move a workspace to a new plan, all existing API keys, webhooks and automation rules keep running – they’re tied to the workspace, not the plan, so no re‑configuration is needed. The only thing that can change are tier‑gated automation features:
• If a rule uses a capability that **is** available on the new tier, it will activate automatically once the migration finishes.
• If a rule depends on a capability that the new tier **doesn’t** include, the rule is paused (not deleted) and will reactivate automatically if you ever move back to a tier that provides it.
You can see exactly which rules will be paused before you confirm the migration by going to **Settings → Automation → Rules**, which shows the status of every rule.
Let me know if you need any more details!
